# Generated by gen_p01.py - do not edit by hand.
source independent dict model in tools/gen_p01.py, cross-checked with React 19.3.1 createElement
seed 1
compare records element=n,json props=name,json
explain _lines=R1
requirement R1 An element is an object with exactly `type` and `props`; `type` is the first argument and `props` holds every given prop
requirement R2 `props.children` is always an array of the children in order: empty for none, one entry for one child
requirement R3 A string or number child becomes a text element with `nodeValue` as given (a number stays a number)
requirement R4 An element given as a child is placed in `children` unchanged, at its position
requirement R5 Props of `null` behave like an empty object
requirement R6 The props object you were given is never modified
requirement R7 `key` is an ordinary prop and stays in `props`
requirement E2E Whole trees built from several calls
case 01-R1-bare-div R1
title div with null props and no children
input
call div null
expected
element 1 {"props":{"children":[]},"type":"div"}
end

title div with id and className
input
call div {"id":"main","className":"wide"}
expected
element 1 {"props":{"children":[],"className":"wide","id":"main"},"type":"div"}
end
